name: Digital Hologram Numerical Reconstruction
definition: Reconstructs the complex wavefield from a loaded hologram matrix using either the Angular Spectrum Method (ASM) or the Fresnel approximation.
summary: Digital Hologram Numerical Reconstruction computes complex wavefields from holograms to visualize 3D scenes, distinguishing itself by propagating fields via frequency domain or quadratic phase approximations rather than summing voxel contributions.
